title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF ONE THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-SIX DOLLARS AND EIGHTY CENTS, MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, TO BE PAID TO JOHN STRINGER, IN FULL COMPENSATION FOR HIS SERVICES AND EXPENSES IN APPREHENDING AND DELIVERING TO THE AUTHORITIES OF MANILA EDWARD L. title.vi: Đạo luật cấp 1.276,80 đô la Mỹ để bồi thường đầy đủ cho John Stringer vì dịch vụ và chi phí ông bỏ ra nhằm bắt giữ và giao nộp Edward L. Waite, một người bị tình nghi trốn tránh công lý, cho cơ quan chức năng Manila

title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan jumlah seribu dua ratus tujuh puluh enam dolar delapan puluh sen mata uang Amerika Serikat untuk dibayarkan kepada John Stringer sebagai kompensasi penuh atas jasa dan biaya yang dikeluarkannya dalam menangkap serta menyerahkan Edward L. text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of one thousand two hundred and seventy-six dollars and eighty cents, United States currency, to be
paid to John Stringer, special agent of the Department of Justice of the United States, in full compensation
for his services and expenses in apprehending and delivering to the authorities of Manila Edward L. Waite,
an alleged fugitive from justice charged with embezzlement.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 15, 1903.
